slides.title: UN moves more aid to northern Ethiopia
slides.body: Tigray, Amhara and Afar: needs are outpacing relief, OCHA says.

slides.title: What OCHA says
slides.body: UN humanitarians say they are mobilizing extra resources, including by reprioritizing existing funding. OCHA again called for urgent new funding.

slides.title: What is being delivered
slides.body: Amhara: 428+ tonnes of WFP food in North Gondar and Wag Hemra. Tigray: 45 World Vision food trucks reached Shire on Oct 26. Afar: water, hygiene supplies and cash aid.

slides.title: Access depends on talks
slides.body: The UN coordinator is engaging federal and regional authorities for safe access. No funding target was given.

slides.title: Safe, open access for all aid.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
